title: Guest can check availability and browse matching rooms
body:
As a guest visitor,
I want to check availability for a stay,
so that I can browse rooms available for my selected dates.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Guest can open the home page.
- Guest can use Check Availability & Book Your Stay.
- Guest can enter check-in date 29/07/2026 and check-out date 30/07/2026.
- Guest sees the Our Rooms section after searching.
- Guest sees available Single and Double room cards with prices and facilities.
- Guest can choose an available room to continue booking.

Steps:
- Navigate to the home page.
- Enter check-in date 29/07/2026.
- Enter check-out date 30/07/2026.
- Submit the availability search.
- Verify room cards remain visible.
- Verify a booking action is available.

Automation Notes:
- Use existing page objects where available.
- Report missing availability-search page-object methods separately.
- Only guest and admin roles exist in this demo app.
